name: Split Ball
author: Addicting Games
description: Split Ball is a free puzzle game. Everything is splitting in two, the world, this game, and even you. In this game, you take control of the binary and split the world like so many hairs in a pedantic argument. as the balls spin and bounce carefree through the level your job is to break up their fun by building a wall and blocking them all off. You need to hit a certain percentage of filling the board before you're able to move on. As the game goes on the amount you're supposed to fill in gets higher. but don't worry, you'll never fail because as the game goes on you get better and better. This is a game of reflexes, strategy, and the tactics that hold it all together. Split Ball is a classic game that you may have heard whispered about in hushed voices as people tell tales of their trials and triumphs. It is a fun game, an old game, and inevitably a fulfilling game.
